carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient between the illuminated dorsal-facing edge and the shadowed ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Proninent light caustics from surface refraction are superimposed on the natural pigmentation across the dorsal and lateral regions. Multiple commensal fish are present, including one yellow-and-black striped specimen positioned near the pectoral fin base.
